title: Copper
body:
Description

Copper ore can spawn in Lightslate, Beigeslate, Darkslate, Marble, Smokeslate and (formerly) Prismarine nodes.

The raw form of Copper takes on an orange color.

Putting Copper in a refiner raises the sell price to $32 per stud. Putting that refined Copper through a forge further increases the price to $34 per stud.

Like any other materials in the game, you can use refined and forged Copper to complete schematics.

Trivia

The raw ore seems to be similar to the classic ore Bombastic.

In Mike's Mines, you can find large deposits of this in the form of Raw Copper, on the walls and ceiling.
